lead_raw_text:
The structure of composition Ga16P4F8 (reduced formula Ga4PF2) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 28 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis gives F centers four geometric neighbors (two Ga, two P), Ga centers 9 neighbors (three F, six Ga), and P centers 3 F neighbors, with Ga–F distances of 1.7513–2.3435 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all 28 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts show corner- and edge-sharing between 9-vertex Ga polyhedra, plus corner-sharing between Ga and P polyhedra.
